data.name: Mahen
data.gender_notes: Mahen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mahen is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahana', which means 'great' or 'moon'. In Hindu mythology, Mahen is a name for the moon god, Chandra. He is the god of the night, responsible for the tides and the cycle of the moon. Mahen is also believed to be a symbol of fertility and prosperity. The name Mahen carries the meaning “Moon god” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mahen usually hope their child will grow to embody moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and mystery of the moon and its influence on the tides and human emotions.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
